follow-up time: 3.2 years for VVF patients, 2.8 years for UVF patients
cohort: Patients who underwent laparoscopic repair of UGF between 2003 and 2012 (22 supratrigonal VVF and 31 UVF)
finding: Laparoscopic repair of UGF was found to be a safe and effective procedure with minimal complications and good long-term outcomes.
